items: 【Powerful 13th Gen Intel Processor】 Equipped with Intel Core i3-1315U (6 Cores, 8 Threads, 10MB L3 Cache), reaching up to 4.5GHz with Intel Turbo Boost Technology — delivers smooth multitasking and responsive performance that even outperforms the previous-gen i7-1165G7.

【Windows 11 Pro + Microsoft Office Included】Preloaded with Windows 11 Pro and Office, enjoy secure productivity tools, seamless collaboration, and ready-to-use apps for business, school, or personal use.

【Rich Connectivity for Every Need】Equipped with 2x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A, 1x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C (data only), HDMI, Ethernet Port, headphone/mic combo, and AC power input — connect displays, storage, networks, and peripherals effortlessly.

【High-Speed Wireless & Wired Networking】Stay connected with Wi-Fi 6 for ultra-fast wireless internet and a Ethernet port for reliable wired connections — perfect for video calls, streaming, and large file transfers.
【Recovery & Sustainability】Includes a WOWPC Recovery USB for system restoration and is built with recyclable materials for a more eco-friendly design.
